title: A Lipschitz curve in a Carnot group that is purely unrectifiable by smooth horizontal curves
summary: We construct a Lipschitz curve in the free Carnot group of step 3 with 2 generators that meets every $C^{1}$ horizontal curve in a set of measure zero. This shows that the $C^{1}_{H}$-Lusin property fails in a strong sense in this group, and we deduce that such a curve must be purely $C^1_H$ 1-unrectifiable. Hence 1-rectifiability in Carnot groups is wildly different to its counterpart in Euclidean spaces, wherein the Whitney Extension Theorem guarantees that Lipschitz rectifiability and $C^1$ rectifiability are equivalent.
